weatherType: Transform this driving scene into {value} weather conditions with realistic lighting and road appearance. Preserve camera motion, road layout, and vehicle trajectories.

timeOfDay.morning: Transform this driving scene into early morning with soft low-angle sunlight and long shadows. Preserve camera motion, road layout, and vehicle trajectories.
timeOfDay.noon: Transform this driving scene into midday with bright overhead sunlight and short shadows. Preserve camera motion, road layout, and vehicle trajectories.
timeOfDay.evening: Transform this driving scene into evening dusk with warm low light and vehicle headlights on. Preserve camera motion, road layout, and vehicle trajectories.
timeOfDay.night: Transform this driving scene into night with street lighting and vehicle headlights. Preserve camera motion, road layout, and vehicle trajectories.
